title: Find the biggest number
objective: Keep the largest value seen so far in a changing name, and update it inside a loop.

body.text: To find the biggest item, start a changing name at the smallest value you expect. Visit each item in the list. When an item is greater than the name's value, set the name to that item. After the loop, the name holds the biggest one.

body.title: The largest of four
body.code:
make changing biggest equal to 0
make nums equal to a list of 5, 1, 8, 3
repeat for each n in nums
    if n is greater than biggest
        set biggest to n
say biggest

body.prompt: The program prints 0 because it keeps the smallest value instead of the largest. Make it print 9.
body.starter:
make changing biggest equal to 0
make nums equal to a list of 4, 9, 2, 6
repeat for each n in nums
    if n is less than biggest
        set biggest to n
say biggest
body.solution:
make changing biggest equal to 0
make nums equal to a list of 4, 9, 2, 6
